\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{মঞ্চ} (mônchô)}{মঞ্চ (mônchô)}]{\bn{মঞ্চ} (mônchô) — a stage}

\label{lesson:BN-C527-moncho}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a violin, then the Bengali for to strum.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{মঞ্চ}}
\textbf{\bn{মঞ্চ}} — \emph{mônchô} — \textquotedblleft{}a stage\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{নাটকের} \bn{আগে} \bn{মঞ্চে} \bn{আলো} \bn{জ্বলল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Nāṭôker āge mônche ālo jvôllô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Before the play, the lights came on on the stage.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{মঞ্চ}} (\emph{mônchô}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{mañca}, \textquotedblleft{}a raised platform, a stage\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mônchô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mônchô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Nāṭôker āge mônche ālo jvôllô.} — Before the play, the lights came on on the stage.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a violin, then the Bengali for to strum, then say \emph{mônchô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{মঞ্চ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A stage\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{অভিনয়} \bn{করা} (ôbhinôy kôrā)}{অভিনয় করা (ôbhinôy kôrā)}]{\bn{অভিনয়} \bn{করা} (ôbhinôy kôrā) — to act on stage; to act in a film}

\label{lesson:BN-C527-obhinoy-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to strum, then the Bengali for a stage.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{অভিনয়} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{অভিনয়} \bn{করা}} — \emph{ôbhinôy kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to act on stage; to act in a film\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমার} \bn{বোন} \bn{স্কুলের} \bn{নাটকে} \bn{অভিনয়} \bn{করল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āmār bon skuler nāṭôke ôbhinôy kôrlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My sister acted in the school play.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{সিনেমায়} \bn{অভিনয়} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini sinemāy ôbhinôy kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{অভিনয়} \bn{করা}} (\emph{ôbhinôy kôrā}) joins \bn{অভিনয়}, Sanskrit \emph{abhinaya}, the art of showing feeling by look and gesture (Monier-Williams), to \bn{করা}, \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôbhinôy kôrā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôbhinôy kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āmār bon skuler nāṭôke ôbhinôy kôrlô.} — My sister acted in the school play.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to strum, then the Bengali for a stage, then say \emph{ôbhinôy kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{অভিনয়} \bn{করা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To act on stage; to act in a film\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{অভিনেতা} (ôbhinetā)}{অভিনেতা (ôbhinetā)}]{\bn{অভিনেতা} (ôbhinetā) — an actor}

\label{lesson:BN-C527-obhineta}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a stage, then the Bengali for to act on stage.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{অভিনেতা}}
\textbf{\bn{অভিনেতা}} — \emph{ôbhinetā} — \textquotedblleft{}an actor\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{এই} \bn{সিনেমার} \bn{অভিনেতা} \bn{বিখ্যাত।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Ei sinemār ôbhinetā bikhyātô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The actor in this film is famous.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{অভিনেতা}} (\emph{ôbhinetā}) is Sanskrit \emph{abhinetṛ}, \textquotedblleft{}one who brings near\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams); the sense \textquotedblleft{}actor\textquotedblright{} is modern, made to go with \emph{abhinaya}, acting.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôbhinetā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôbhinetā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Ei sinemār ôbhinetā bikhyātô.} — The actor in this film is famous.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a stage, then the Bengali for to act on stage, then say \emph{ôbhinetā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{অভিনেতা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An actor\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{রিহার্সাল} (rihārsāl)}{রিহার্সাল (rihārsāl)}]{\bn{রিহার্সাল} (rihārsāl) — a rehearsal}

\label{lesson:BN-C527-riharsal}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to act on stage, then the Bengali for an actor.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{রিহার্সাল}}
\textbf{\bn{রিহার্সাল}} — \emph{rihārsāl} — \textquotedblleft{}a rehearsal\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{নাটকের} \bn{আগে} \bn{আমরা} \bn{এক} \bn{সপ্তাহ} \bn{রিহার্সাল} \bn{করলাম।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Nāṭôker āge āmrā ek sôptāhô rihārsāl kôrlām.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Before the play we rehearsed for a week.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{রিহার্সাল}} (\emph{rihārsāl}) is borrowed from English \emph{rehearsal}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{rihārsāl}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{rihārsāl}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Nāṭôker āge āmrā ek sôptāhô rihārsāl kôrlām.} — Before the play we rehearsed for a week.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to act on stage, then the Bengali for an actor, then say \emph{rihārsāl} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{হাততালি} (hāttāli)}{হাততালি (hāttāli)}]{\bn{হাততালি} (hāttāli) — applause; clapping}

\label{lesson:BN-C527-hattali}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for an actor, then the Bengali for a rehearsal.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{হাততালি}}
\textbf{\bn{হাততালি}} — \emph{hāttāli} — \textquotedblleft{}applause; clapping\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{দর্শকরা} \bn{অভিনেতাদের} \bn{জন্য} \bn{হাততালি} \bn{দিল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Dôrshôkrā ôbhinetāder jônyô hāttāli dilô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The audience applauded the actors.
\end{quote}

With \bn{দেওয়া}: \bn{হাততালি} \bn{দেওয়া}, to clap.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{হাততালি}} (\emph{hāttāli}) joins \bn{হাত}, \textquotedblleft{}hand\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 14024), and \bn{তালি}, \textquotedblleft{}clapping\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 5748): the clapping of hands.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hāttāli}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hāttāli}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Dôrshôkrā ôbhinetāder jônyô hāttāli dilô.} — The audience applauded the actors.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for an actor, then the Bengali for a rehearsal, then say \emph{hāttāli} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{হাততালি} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Applause; clapping\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
